predictions.pred_a_authority_hashes_disjointness_fin: all authorities are sealed; fresh targets do not overlap fit rows; refit tensor hashes exactly reproduce both frozen projector families
predictions.pred_b_both_frozen_projectors_transfer_c: for each projector, worst normalized target residual <= 0.15 and temporal/is-was signed behavior projection >= 0.70
predictions.pred_c_transfer_survives_activation_nois: at 10% sitewise donor-delta RMS noise, every seed/projector has worst target residual <= 0.25 and both task projections >= 0.60
predictions.pred_d_controls_are_output_inert: each projector has normalized control margin RMS <= 0.10 per control task, median full-vocabulary KL(base||projected) <= 0.02 nat, and top-1 flip fraction <= 0.05

decision: All five predictions support a stable reusable response program. Clean-only success with noise or KL failure is classified as a memorization/fragility null. Authority or hash failure is invalid.
